jobs.title: CRM Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
***\*Equal Opportunity Employer Veterans/Disabled\****
======================================================

**SUMMARY:**

The organization seeks a CRM Systems Analyst to support Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales for PEI-Genesis’s global sales organization. In this capacity, the role provides application support to CRM users, configures the platform to meet business needs through the CRM sprint process, and develops and maintains both user process and technical documentation. The role also partners with business stakeholders to document requirements, and plans and executes user acceptance testing and application testing to ensure changes meet those requirements before release. This is an early-career opportunity with room to grow, and software development experience is not required.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

* Required
  + 2+ years of CRM experience in an administrator, support, or analyst role.
  + Hands-on experience planning or running UAT or application testing.
  + Experience writing user documentation.
* Preferred
  + Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field.
  + Microsoft Dynamics 365 experience, with Sales Hub as the primary application.
  + Experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys or another marketing application.
  + Power Automate experience.
  + Jira experience.
  + Microsoft Dynamics 365 certification.
  + Experience working for companies in distribution and/or discrete manufacturing.

**ESSENTIAL TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Application Support
  + Serves as a primary point of contact for CRM-related questions and issues.
  + Troubleshoots and resolves help desk tickets, including access, security role, data, and how-to requests, and escalates what needs deeper technical work.
  + Provides basic end user support for Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Insights - Journeys.
  + Tracks recurring issues and brings them to the sprint backlog.
* System Configuration
  + Configures Dynamics 365 using standard tools: forms, views, dashboards, business rules, and security roles.
  + Builds simple Power Automate flows where needed.
  + Assists in delivering enhancements through the CRM sprint process, guided by the business-led sprint prioritization.
* Documentation
  + Writes and maintains user process documentation: how-to guides, quick reference sheets, and release notes.
  + Writes and maintains lightly technical documentation: configuration, field definitions, business rules, and data relationships.
  + Updates documentation as changes ship so it matches the live system.
* Testing and Quality Assurance
  + Plans and runs UAT for CRM enhancements and releases with sales managers and power users and obtains business sign-off before release.
  + Writes and executes test cases in non-production environments, including regression testing of configuration changes and Microsoft release wave updates.
  + Logs defects, tracks them to resolution, and retests fixes.
* Requirements and Analysis
  + Documents business requirements and acceptance criteria from stakeholder conversations.
  + Analyzes existing configuration and data to identify problems and propose fixes.

**SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:**

* Testing and Quality Assurance
  + Writes clear test cases and acceptance criteria.
  + Facilitates UAT with business users and keeps testers on schedule.
  + Tracks defects and verifies fixes.
  + Pays close attention to detail.
* CRM and Microsoft Dynamics 365
  + Working knowledge of CRM administration: users, security roles, forms, views, and workflows.
  + Dynamics 365 Sales experience preferred, with Sales Hub as the primary application.
  + Familiarity with sales process concepts: leads, opportunities, accounts, and contacts.
* Data Fundamentals
  + Understands what a relational database is: tables, relationships, keys, and data types.
  + Can investigate data problems such as duplicates, missing values, and bad imports.
  + Experience with Advanced Find, Excel, SQL, FetchXML, or Power BI is a plus.
* Communication and Documentation
  + Writes clearly for non-technical users and for technical readers.
  + Explains problems and fixes in plain language.
  + Works well with sales teams and with IT colleagues.
* General
  + Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
  + Good organization and time management, including handling several requests at once.
  + Works independently and as part of a team.
  + Wants to learn and grow in the role.

jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary

**Location**  
Remote.  
  
**Experience Level**  
Mid–Senior Level (5+ years of relevant experience).  
  
**Role Overview**  
We are seeking a Data Engineer & Insights Analyst to transform complex data into trusted, usable information that supports program delivery, operational improvements, and executive decision-making. The role focuses on designing and building cloud-based data pipelines, integrating data from multiple sources, and addressing data quality issues. The analyst will also develop dashboards, reports, and analytical products that deliver actionable insights from large, confidential datasets. This position partners with data scientists, research and policy analysts, and cross-functional stakeholders, and supports data conversions tied to system modernization efforts.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Data Pipeline Engineering & Cloud Solutions**

* Create and maintain optimal data pipeline architecture.
* Design and implement cloud-based data solutions using AWS services such as S3, Glue, Redshift, EMR, Athena, Kinesis, and Lambda.
* Build and maintain data orchestration workflows using tools such as Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions, or similar services.
* Build the infrastructure required to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of sources using SQL and big data technologies.
* Assemble large, complex data sets that meet functional and non-functional business requirements.

**Data Quality, Monitoring & Governance**

* Develop and maintain pipeline monitoring, alerting, and logging frameworks.
* Implement data quality checks and validation frameworks across pipelines.
* Ensure compliance with applicable policies, data governance standards, privacy requirements, security controls, and data-sharing agreements.
* Automate manual processes, optimize data delivery, and redesign infrastructure for greater scalability.

**Analytics & Insights Delivery**

* Develop dashboards, reports, analytical models, and other decision-support products.
* Build analytics tools on top of the data pipeline to provide insights into education and workforce outcomes, operational efficiency, and key performance metrics.
* Engineer analytical data environments that support statistical analysis, predictive modeling, machine learning, and evidence-building activities.
* Create data tools that help analysts and data scientists build and optimize data products.

**Collaboration & Delivery**

* Partner with data scientists, research analysts, and policy analysts to support reproducible research and statistical modeling.
* Work with executive, data, design, and support teams to resolve data-related technical issues and meet data infrastructure needs.
* Support data conversions associated with system modernization or replacement efforts.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud-based data services such as AWS (S3, EC2, Glue, EMR, RDS, Redshift, Athena, Lambda, DynamoDB).
* 5+ years of proficiency in object-oriented or functional scripting languages such as Python, R, Java, C++, or Scala.
* 5+ years of proficiency in relational SQL and NoSQL databases, including Oracle, MS SQL Server, Postgres, and Cassandra, with advanced SQL and query authoring skills.
* 5+ years of experience with version control systems such as Git and CI/CD pipelines.
* 5+ years of knowledge of data modeling techniques, including dimensional modeling, data vault, and star/snowflake schemas.
* 5+ years of familiarity with data cataloging and metadata management tools such as AWS Glue Data Catalog.
* 5+ years of understanding of data governance, data lineage, and data quality frameworks.
* 5+ years of knowledge of REST API design and integration patterns.
* 5+ years of experience with big data tools such as Hadoop, Spark, and Kafka.
* 5+ years of experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Azkaban, Luigi, and Airflow.
* 5+ years of experience with data integration solutions from vendors such as Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, and TIBCO.
* 5+ years of experience with stream-processing systems such as Storm and Spark-Streaming.
* Experience building and optimizing big data pipelines, architectures, and data sets, including processes for data transformation, data structures, metadata, dependency, and workload management.
* Advanced proficiency designing, building, and refining dashboards, reports, analytical models, and decision-support products for executive and non-technical users.
* Experience working with student-level higher education data, including linking it to other sources such as employment and wage data to measure outcomes.
* Experience performing root-cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer business questions and identify improvement opportunities.
* Strong analytic skills with unstructured datasets and a history of extracting value from large, disconnected datasets.
* Working knowledge of message queuing, stream processing, and highly scalable big data stores.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with student-level higher education data and linkages to employment and wage data.
* Experience supporting data conversions associated with system modernization or replacement efforts.

**Core Skills & Attributes**

* Work in a self-directed manner while supporting the data needs of multiple teams, systems, and products.
* Apply strong analytical judgment when working with large, complex, and confidential datasets.
* Demonstrate strong project management and organizational skills.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.
* Communicate insights clearly to executive and non-technical audiences.
* Pursue continuous improvement of data systems and functionality.

Flexible work from home options available.

**About Tala**

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.
  
  
The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.

Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.

Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

#### **The Role**

We are looking for aSenior Data Engineer to help build, operate, and continuously improve the data infrastructure that powers analytics and business intelligence across Tala's global markets.

In this individual contributor role, you will take ownership of Tala's data synchronization pipelines, ensuring that data from our market-level databases is reliably captured, processed, and delivered to Snowflake for downstream analytics and business use.

Our data infrastructure uses a modern AWS-based architecture, including AWS Database Migration Service (DMS), Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Apache Iceberg, Amazon S3, and Snowflake. You will work across this ecosystem to ensure data is accurate, available, and delivered with minimal latency.

Beyond maintaining existing pipelines, you will identify opportunities to improve performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency. You will also establish and monitor service level objectives (SLOs), strengthen testing and deployment practices, and lead root cause analysis when issues arise.

This is an opportunity for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex distributed data challenges and takes ownership of production systems from development through operation.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own and operate data pipelines: Maintain and improve Tala's change data capture (CDC) and data synchronization infrastructure, ensuring accurate and timely delivery of data from market-level databases into Snowflake.
* Improve pipeline performance and scalability: Identify and implement improvements to reduce latency, optimize infrastructure costs, and support growing data volumes across markets.
* Build and evolve data infrastructure: Onboard new data sources, tables, and markets while managing schema evolution and ensuring compatibility across systems.
* Drive reliability and data quality: Establish service level objectives (SLOs), implement monitoring and alerting, and build automated data quality checks to ensure data remains accurate and available.
* Strengthen engineering practices: Develop and maintain unit and integration tests, CI/CD workflows, infrastructure-as-code, and safe deployment strategies, including dry runs and blue-green deployments.
